02 / About

A multidisciplinary
creative practice.

I’m Dina Fahmi, a creative director, artist and vocalist based in Cairo. My work spans graphic design, brand identity, fashion, illustration and fine art, alongside music and film.

Across these disciplines, my focus is on thoughtful visual expression: a distinctive identity, a considered composition, a story communicated through image or voice.
